subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Comparar palavras, identificando semelhanças e diferenças entre sons de sílabas mediais e finais.

components.description_pt: Identificar sons semelhantes em sílabas mediais de palavras diferentes
components.description_en: Identify similar sounds in the medial syllables of different words
components.cc_component_description: Isolate and pronounce the medial vowel sound in a CVC word

components.description_pt: Comparar palavras descrevendo diferenças em sons de sílabas mediais e finais
components.description_en: Compare words by describing differences in their medial and final syllable sounds
components.cc_component_description: Isolate and pronounce initial, medial, and final phonemes in spoken words

cc_matches.description: Isolate and pronounce the initial, medial vowel, and final sounds (phonemes) in three-phoneme (consonent-vowel-consonent, or CVC) words. (This does not include CVCs ending with /l/, /r/, or /x/.)
Demonstrate understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes).
